detail: The prior before string used U+0014 and U+0017 control characters in place of source U+2014 EM DASH and U+00B7 MIDDLE DOT. Exact bytes are required. No stage was created.
actualFunctionText:
export function renderNotFoundPage({ site }) { return String(html` Page not found — ${site.name} Skip to content
${site.name}
${site.menu.map((m) => html`${m.label}`)}

404

Page not found

The requested page does not exist. Return to the site index.

${site.name} · ${site.license}

`); }
